author: LivePaper
description: A sumi-e dusk mountain range in handmade charcoal paper under a low vermilion sun, gently alive: gnarled pines on the crag and ridge crests sway as gusts travel through them, mist layers drift and breathe at their own depths, a few dry-brush cloud wisps form, drift and dissolve across a quiet sky, a slow river shimmers with the sun's broken reflection, a boat lantern flickers and sheds embers, and a small flock passes now and then.
name: Ink and Ember
